_comment: Template for --inputs when assembling a Fedora image. Paths may be relative and are resolved against this file's directory. SENSOR_STACK_SHA256 is a digest, not a path. POWER_SETTINGS_BINARY may be omitted: the assembly then installs no power panel, and the result is a working tablet whose Power panel lacks the project's button-policy controls. See docs/FEDORA.zh-CN.md.
_fingerprint: FINGERPRINT_BUNDLE is the public fingerprint-build-inputs.tar.gz from the project's own release, the same file the Ubuntu path uses; it is not a Fedora build product. LIBFPRINT_TOD_TAR is the archive build-liuqin-fedora-libfprint-tod.sh writes, required here because Fedora publishes no libfprint-2-tod package at all. Neither is optional, and neither has a digest: the first pins its own contents, and the second is verified as it is built.
_firmware: FIRMWARE_POOL is the raw vendor pool the first-boot initramfs reads; FIRMWARE_TREE is the prepared tree build-liuqin-firmware-prep.sh emits. The root assembler installs the /usr/lib/firmware closure from the latter.
_installer: INSTALLER_IMG must come from the SAME release as the kernel this bundle is assembled against, and not merely any release: install.py booting it into RAM compares the installer's 'uname -r' with the bundle's kernel_release and aborts on any difference. A v0.2.0 installer carries 6.17.0-rc1-gb07784536640 and stops a v0.6.0 bundle before it touches a single partition.
_topology: AUDIO_TOPOLOGY is not the copy an older release's rootfs carries: upstream rebuilt the topology for the onboard microphone capture chain, and both builders now enforce its new hash, so the stale file fails the initramfs step with 'AudioReach topology identity mismatch'. Recover the shipped one from a v0.6.0 boot.img with tools/import-liuqin-release-topology.sh, or build it from AudioReach source with tools/build-liuqin-audio-topology.sh.
